description: Company: EnergyScape Renewables Location: Kochi Infopark, Kerala Job Type: Internship Department: Marketing Experience: Freshers and candidates with relevant academic or project experience welcome About EnergyScape Renewables EnergyScape Renewables is your all-in-one solar ecosystem, providing comprehensive pre-installation services and technology solutions to solar installers and EPCs across the United States. Our services include solar permitting, engineering plan sets, PE stamping, utility applications, site surveys, and sales proposals. We are looking for: A detail-oriented and analytical Marketing Analyst Intern to support our marketing team in analyzing campaign performance, researching market trends, tracking key performance indicators (KPIs), and identifying opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness. Role Overview As a Marketing Analyst Intern, you will work closely with the marketing team to collect and analyze marketing data, Monitor digital campaign performance, conduct competitor research, and prepare reports that support data-driven Marketing decisions. This role offers hands-on experience in digital marketing analytics, market research, and B2B marketing within the US solar industry. Key Responsibilities Marketing Analytics: Collect, organize, and analyze marketing data across digital channels to evaluate campaign performance and marketing effectiveness. Campaign Performance Tracking: Monitor KPIs such as website traffic, engagement, click-through rates, conversion rates, lead generation, and campaign ROI. Market Research: Research the US solar industry, target audiences, emerging trends, and potential market opportunities. Competitor Analysis: Analyze competitors’ marketing strategies, website content, social media presence, positioning, and promotional activities. SEO Analysis: Assist with keyword research, website performance tracking, organic traffic analysis, and identification of SEO improvement opportunities. Social Media Analytics: Track performance across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, and X, identifying content trends and opportunities for improvement. Lead Generation Analysis: Monitor marketing-generated leads, lead sources, conversion trends, and campaign effectiveness. Reporting and Dashboards: Prepare weekly and monthly marketing performance reports using spreadsheets, dashboards, and presentation tools. Data Visualization: Translate marketing data into clear charts, reports, and actionable insights for the marketing team. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with content, design, and sales teams to support campaign planning, execution, and performance optimization. Required Skills and Qualifications Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Statistics, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field. Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills. Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets. Basic understanding of digital marketing concepts, including SEO, social media marketing, website analytics, and lead generation. Ability to interpret data, identify patterns, and communicate findings clearly. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills. Willingness to learn new marketing tools, analytics platforms, and reporting techniques. Preferred Qualifications Familiarity with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Search Console. Basic knowledge of Google Looker Studio or other data visualization tools. Exposure to CRM platforms and marketing automation tools. Understanding of LinkedIn Campaign Manager or Meta Ads Manager. Experience with keyword research and competitor analysis tools. Interest in B2B marketing, renewable energy, or the US solar industry. What You Will Learn Practical experience in B2B marketing analytics and campaign measurement. How to evaluate digital marketing performance using data. Market research and competitor benchmarking techniques. SEO performance analysis and website traffic reporting. Lead generation tracking and marketing funnel analysis. Data visualization, reporting, and insight-driven decision-making. Exposure to marketing strategies targeting the US renewable energy market. Who Should Apply? We are looking for curious, motivated, and detail-oriented individuals who enjoy working with data and want to understand how marketing decisions are made. If you are eager to learn, comfortable working with spreadsheets, and interested in connecting data with business outcomes, this internship is an excellent opportunity to build your marketing analytics skills. How to Apply Interested candidates can share their resume at resumes@energyscaperenewables.com. title: Business Analyst
description: About the Role We are looking for a Business Analyst & Process Improvement Specialist to analyze business processes, identify operational gaps, gather business requirements, and drive process improvements across the organization. The ideal candidate will have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, experience in business process analysis, requirements gathering, process mapping, stakeholder management, and data-driven decision-making, with the ability to translate business needs into practical solutions. Key Responsibilities Analyze existing business processes and identify gaps, bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities. Conduct AS-IS and TO-BE process analysis and develop optimized workflows. Gather, analyze, document, and validate business requirements from stakeholders. Conduct stakeholder interviews, workshops, discussions, and requirement-gathering sessions. Prepare and maintain BRDs, FRDs/FSDs, SRS, user stories, process flows, use cases, SOPs, and requirement documentation . Perform gap analysis, impact analysis, root cause analysis, and process analysis . Develop process maps, workflows, flowcharts, and other visual documentation. Work closely with business, operations, technology, and other cross-functional teams to understand business challenges and implement solutions. Identify opportunities for process standardization, automation, cost reduction, time reduction, and productivity improvement . Define and monitor KPIs and performance metrics to measure process effectiveness. Analyze business and operational data to identify trends, issues, and opportunities for improvement. Prepare MIS reports, dashboards, management reports, and business insights as required. Support implementation of new processes, systems, and business solutions. Track process changes and measure the impact of implemented improvements. Identify potential risks and dependencies associated with proposed process changes. Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), implementation, and post-implementation review where required. Prepare SOPs and process documentation to ensure consistent adoption of improved processes. Communicate findings, recommendations, and improvement plans to management and relevant stakeholders. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Business Analytics, Finance, Computer Science, Engineering, Operations, or a related field . 2–4years of experience in Business Analysis, Process Improvement, Business Operations, Consulting, or a related role. Strong hands-on experience in business process analysis and improvement . Experience in requirements gathering and stakeholder management . Strong understanding of AS-IS / TO-BE process mapping and gap analysis . Experience creating process flows, workflows, SOPs, BRDs, FRDs/FSDs, SRS, or user stories . Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Good knowledge of MS Excel , including Pivot Tables, formulas, lookups, data analysis, and reporting. Experience with process mapping/documentation tools such as Visio, Lucidchart, Draw.io, or similar tools is preferred. Knowledge of Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or similar project management tools is an advantage. Basic knowledge of SQL / data analysis is an advantage. Strong communication and presentation skills. Ability to work independently as well as collaborate with cross-functional teams. Strong attention to detail with a structured and data-driven approach. Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month Application Question(s): How many years of professional experience do you have in Business Analysis, Process Improvement, or Business Operations? title: Senior Systems Analyst
description: Introduction Welcome to Gallagher in India — where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging. Overview The Senior Systems Analyst supports production operations for business-critical applications, systems, workflows, integrations, and related business processes. This role serves as a bridge between business users, support teams, vendors, and development teams by driving issue resolution, managing system administration, coordinating operational processes, and ensuring work progresses efficiently through support and development lifecycles. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who can work independently, communicate effectively with technical and business stakeholders, and consistently execute established operational and development processes with minimal supervision. How you'll make an impact Monitor production systems, workflows, integrations, and critical business processes to identify issues, performance concerns, and operational risks. Troubleshoot and coordinate resolution of production incidents, working with business users and developers as needed. Perform and validate system configuration, user administration, and access management. Manage root cause analysis activities and recommend corrective actions to prevent recurring issues. Drive work through established Jira workflows, ensuring tickets are properly documented, prioritized, assigned, and progressed through support and SDLC processes. Manage change and release processes, including CRQs, deployment coordination, production readiness reviews, implementation activities, post-release validation, and operational stabilization. Maintain support documentation, operational procedures, dashboards, and reporting related to system performance, backlog health, and production support activities. Identify opportunities to improve support processes, system stability, monitoring, and operational efficiency. Support projects involving system enhancements, integrations, and other technology initiatives. About you REQUIRED 4+ years of experience in systems analysis, application support, technology operations, or similar hands-on support roles. Experience supporting business-critical applications in a production environment. Experience with incident management, root cause analysis, and issue resolution coordination. Experience with system configuration, user administration, and operational support processes. Experience using Jira or similar platforms to manage work through support and software development lifecycles. Experience managing or coordinating change requests, releases, or production deployments. Experience working directly with business users, developers, and vendors in a production support environment. Demonstrated ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, overcome obstacles, and consistently follow established operational, change management, and SDLC procedures. Ability to gather requirements and ensure work is sufficiently documented to progress through support and development workflows. PREFERRED Experience supporting insurance, healthcare, higher education, or customer-facing administrative platforms. Experience with SQL, reporting tools, dashboards, and data analysis. Experience supporting integrations, APIs, file transfers, and scheduled processes. Experience with ITIL, change management, release management, or service operations frameworks. Experience with Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or similar collaboration tools. Experience using AI-assisted tools for documentation, analysis, and operational reporting. Additional Information At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page. Competitive compensation Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well-being Career development opportunities and ongoing learning A collaborative, people-first culture with accessible leadership The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact At Gallagher, we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to join our Talent Community to stay connected to additional career opportunities. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. Gallagher is an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)
